slot_scores.name: protein_selection_rule
slot_scores.evidence_quote: Should the model allow selecting any of the seven listed foods (salmon, beef, pork, okra, carrots, celery, cabbage) in any non-negative amounts, or are the three meats (salmon, beef, pork) excluded from the dinner plan?
slot_scores.rationale: The agent explicitly probed the protein-selection rule by asking whether the meats may be freely selected/combined in any amounts or excluded, which targets whether multiple proteins can be combined versus a discrete choice.

slot_scores.name: min_vegetable_types
slot_scores.rationale: The agent never explicitly asked about the minimum number of vegetable types; it only issued a vague catch-all ('any other requirements or restrictions') that does not target vegetable variety, so the at-least-two-vegetables rule was obtained solely because the user volunteered it.

stopping_behavior.rationale: The agent entered READY_TO_MODEL while the P1 vegetable-variety rule (H2) had never been explicitly asked about; it was only surfaced by the user's answer to a generic catch-all question.

summary: The agent reasonably probed the protein-selection rule but never explicitly asked about the minimum number of vegetable types, relying on a vague catch-all and then a follow-up about hardness, so H2 was resolved only by user volunteering. Several data-type questions were left unconfirmed but were at least explicitly flagged as assumptions, and the stop was premature with respect to the unresolved vegetable-variety slot.

restoration_summary.rule: Exact restoration uses only P0/P1 slots; unresolved P2 slots do not affect exact restoration.

stopping_consistency_audit.rule: Any non-yes P0/P1 slot at READY_TO_MODEL is unresolved.
